company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Research Engineer Associate
positions.description:
Hardware Team Member (1/2020 - present):
  Programming and testing of an MSP430 “clock board” with multiple competing timing sources in C 
    using JTAG connection in IAR
  Programming and testing of an MSP430 “supervisor board” in C (JTAG/IAR)
  Writing LabVIEW “topside” code to interact with flashed board stacks
  Programming a TCRTC in TI-RTOS using Code Composer Studio

Software Team Member (11/2015 - 12/2020):
Wrote Bash/Python scripts, and created mySQL databases to turn raw data into organized sets for lab analysts
Performed full OS and software installs, updates, and other system administrator tasks to maintain and create sponsor computer systems
Handled security of sponsor hardware, such as frequent ACAS scans, RHEL7 system hardening, and software patching
